plan.thoughts: Monday has two fixed Seahawks viewings, a strong morning lineup around Lake Sawyer and Franklin, and solid pickleball and Ten Trails crowds in the evening, so I built ten small groups that cover 41 different neighbors. Where I could, I grouped people by shared interests and stage of life: history fans at Franklin, photographers on the birding walk, parents with kids at the bakery and on the dog walk, retiree card players at cribbage, and four runners in their late 50s at Ten Trails. I checked each fixed time against what people avoid. The 5:20pm game ends at 8:30, so I left the 'avoids late nights' people out of that group, and nobody who avoids early mornings is in the afternoon game. I skipped hoops, with only three people per room, and the evening Lake Sawyer dog walk, with only two. I also skipped second groups for Franklin, pickleball and Ten Trails so the plans reach more people instead of the same rooms twice. Alternates are unique across groups.
